(ii) Dominance, Codominance and Incomplete dominance
questions.solution:
(i) Polygenic Inheritance-Inheritance of a trait that is controlled by three or more genes / the phenotype reflects contribution of all alleles (three or more) and effect of each allele is additive.
Pleiotropy - When a single gene shows multiple phenotypic expressions.
(ii) Dominance - In heterozygous pair of gene dominant allele is expressed over the recessive allele/ F1 progeny resemble either of the two parents which is dominant.
Codominance - In a pair of genes when both alleles express themselves/ F1 generation(one of the progeny) resembles both the parents.
Incomplete dominance - When in heterozygous state none of the allele is able to express itself and phenotype is in between/ Phenotype of F1 progeny is in between the two parent.
